# llms.txt — AI 可读索引

> 2026-10-29
> This file helps AI agents understand the structure of this knowledge base.

## Overview
This is a GitHub-based knowledge management system. All knowledge lives as Markdown files organized by category. AI agents should read, maintain, and extend this knowledge base.

## Structure

### Content Directory
- `content/notes/` — Personal knowledge notes, organized by category
  - `ai/` — AI, LLM, machine learning
  - `engineering/` — Software engineering, architecture
  - `business/` — Business, strategy, marketing
  - `design/` — UI/UX, visual design
  - `life/` — Personal growth, habits, health
- `content/team/` — Team-shared documentation
- `content/public/` — Public-facing articles (blog posts)
- `content/_templates/` — Markdown templates for new content

### Key Files
- `CLAUDE.md` — AI agent maintenance rules (read this first)
- `AGENTS.md` — Agent interface specification
- `_config.yml` — Site configuration
- `scripts/` — Automation scripts
- `.github/workflows/` — CI/CD pipelines

## How to Use
1. Read `CLAUDE.md` first for maintenance rules
2. Search `content/` for relevant knowledge
3. Use `scripts/build_search_index.py` to rebuild search
4. Use `scripts/extract_knowledge.py` for AI processing
